question.prompt: An item costs 40 yuan per unit to purchase. When sold at 60 yuan per unit, 100 units can be sold each day. For every 1 yuan reduction in the price per unit, 10 more units are sold each day. If the daily profit is to be 2160 yuan and customers are to receive greater savings, by how many yuan should the price per unit be reduced? (Unit: yuan.)

solutions.explanation: Let the price reduction be \(x\) yuan. Then \((60-x-40)(100+10x)=2160\), which simplifies to \(x^2-10x+16=0\), giving \(x=2\) or \(8\). To give customers greater savings, choose the larger price reduction, 8.
solutions.title: Balance unit profit and increased sales
